inspiration: Look by slot, not by file: each NPC points to up to nine sprite slots (sprites1 to sprites9 in NpcDefs.json) and many creatures share a slot. Recreate: a creature table where a look is a slot number and a palette swap, so one art set makes several creatures.

The top six creatures by combat level in NpcDefs.json (ids 477, 291, 568, 769, 290, 705) carry respawn times from 30 to 75 seconds, and four of the six are aggressive. A rare, aggressive top tier with a long respawn reads as a feared spawn. Recreate: our top-tier spawn with a grace timer and a zone cap (row 23).

Tiered kill ladder (defs/extras/CombatOdyssey.json): 14 tiers, 101 tasks. Each tier has a master and tasks made of NPC groups with kill counts. Recreate: a zone ladder where each step names a group and a count, with progress visible on the HUD.

Paired hit sounds: combat1a and combat1b, then combat2a and combat2b, then combat3a and combat3b (Client_Base/Cache/audio). Two variants per hit tier give repeats without a loop. Recreate: our own pairs with a different impact tail per weapon class.

Custom art kept in its own id band: the client takes a different branch for animation ids 230 and above when custom sprites are on (Client_Base/src/orsc/mudclient.java line 6362). Recreate: our custom pack lives in its own id range so base art and new art never collide.
Placement as data: NpcLocs.json, SceneryLocs.json and GroundItems.json hold where things sit (server/conf/server/defs/locs/). A walk-density table per zone can be built from the same idea.

briefs.label: Tier-top brute
briefs.why: A rare, aggressive top-tier spawn with a long respawn reads as a threat that a player plans around. The donor data shows the shape: high combat level, aggressive, long respawn (NpcDefs.json line 18606 for id 477; sprite slot at line 18621).
briefs.keep: rarity from respawn time; aggressive by default; one slot shared with a sibling creature
briefs.change: our brute is a plated quadruped with its own silhouette and palette; spawn is capped and gated by a grace timer in the zone data, not a fixed respawn
briefs.ref: server/conf/server/defs/NpcDefs.json lines 18606 and 18621 (id 477, sprites1 165); not visually opened

briefs.label: Hit-pair sound variants
briefs.why: Two variants per hit tier stop repeats from sounding identical in a long fight, without a larger sound set.
briefs.keep: a/b pairs per hit tier (three tiers)
briefs.change: our pairs carry a different impact tail per weapon class and sit under our own stinger, not the donor's cue
briefs.ref: Client_Base/Cache/audio/combat1a.wav, combat1b.wav, combat2a.wav, combat3a.wav (names only, not played)

briefs.label: Zone kill ladder
briefs.why: A ladder of themed kill lists with counts turns a zone into a set of goals and shows progress in one line.
briefs.keep: 14 tiers with NPC groups and kill counts per task
briefs.change: our ladder is per zone and per biome, with one boss step, and rewards are zone currency not donor items

briefs.label: Custom art id band
briefs.why: A separate id range for added art keeps the base set stable while new content ships.
briefs.keep: custom ids in their own range checked by one condition
briefs.change: our range is set per content pack in the data, not one hard-coded number in the client loop
briefs.ref: Client_Base/src/orsc/mudclient.java line 6362 (condition only; branch body not read)
